programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: South Park: Freak Strike
programme.desc: Freak Strike: The boys decide to create a freak in order to win a prize on a TV show - will Butters' case of "Chinballalitis" be enough to win? And will he be discovered by the freaks union? (S6, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: Asspen: When the boys go on a ski vacation, it's '80s-teen-movie central as Stan is challenged to a ski race by a professional skier named Tad. Only a "montage" can help Stan now! (S6, E02)

programme.title: South Park: The New Terrance and Phillip Move Trailer
programme.desc: The Terrance and Phillip Movie Trailer: The gang are desperate to see the Terrance and Phillip trailer (featuring during 'The Russell Crowe Show') but events conspire against them. (S6, E05)
programme.sub-title: The New Terrance and Phillip Move Trailer

programme.title: South Park: Fun with Veal
programme.desc: Fun With Veal: When the boys discover that veal is made from baby cows they are horrified. Time for a "terrorist" mission to rescue the poor little blighters from their deathly fate! (S6, E04)

programme.title: South Park: Krazy Kripples
programme.desc: Krazy K******s: Christopher Reeve arrives in town and Jimmy and Timmy aren't happy with the attention he gets. They form a club called "The Crips" - unaware of the gang that shares the name! (S7, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Toilet Paper
programme.desc: Toilet Paper: Mrs. Dreibel gives the boys detention for making a phallus out of clay in art class. Angry, they take revenge by toilet papering her house. Officer Barbrady is on their trail. (S7, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Fat Butt and Pancake Head
programme.desc: Fat Butt and Pancake Head: When Cartman wins a diversity event with his offensive hand puppet impersonation of Jennifer Lopez, Kyle is enraged. Soon the real J-Lo turns up, mightily peeved! (S7, E05)

programme.title: South Park: Lil' Crime Stoppers
programme.desc: Lil' Crime Stoppers: Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny decide to play detective; they go around the town solving minor "crimes" for a dollar. It's not long before they're busting meth labs! (S7, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Red Man's Greed
programme.desc: Red Man's Greed: When the entire town is bought out by a Native American casino, the boys come up with a plan to get their homes back - but is more gambling really the solution? (S7, E07)

programme.title: South Park: South Park Is Gay
programme.desc: South Park is Gay! The TV show Queer Eye For The Straight Guy is sweeping the nation and the men of South Park are embracing metrosexuality, but what evil plan are the hosts plotting? (S7, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Christian Rock Hard
programme.desc: Christian Hard Rock: The boys form a band called Moop, but disagree on what direction they should take. Cartman leaves the band and bets them he will have a platinum record first! (S7, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Grey Dawn
programme.desc: Grey Dawn: There's an epidemic in South Park. An epidemic of senior citizen related driving accidents! When their licenses are all revoked they decide to fight back military style! (S7, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Casa Bonita: Cartman is overjoyed at going to a Mexican restaurant for Kyle's birthday but is crushed when he finds out Butters is invited instead. He'll have to make Butters "disappear". (S7, E11)

programme.title: South Park: All About Mormons
programme.desc: All About The Mormons: A new family moves to South Park and their son Gary is an unusually perfect Mormon - this angers the boys no end! Will Stan beat him up or go for a family dinner?! (S7, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Butt Out
programme.desc: Butt Out: When the boys' smoking leads to a nasty incident, it's the cigarettes that are blamed rather than them. Cue the glutinous Rob Reiner to arrive in town with his anti-smoking lobby! (S7, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Raisins
programme.desc: Raisins: When Wendy breaks up with Stan he takes it hard. The boys decide to take him to the restaurant Raisins, where all of the employees are preteen girls who enjoy wearing heavy make-up. (S7, E14)

programme.title: South Park: It's Christmas In Canada
programme.desc: It's Christmas In Canada: A law is passed in Canada, meaning poor lil' Ike must return to his biological parents. The boys set out to stop this but who is the evil mastermind behind the law? (S7, E15)

programme.title: South Park: Good Times with Weapons
programme.desc: Good Times With Weapons: After buying martial arts weapons at a local flea market, the boys are transformed into anime Japanese Warriors, with dire consequences for poor Professor Chaos. (S8, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter Than Summer: AWESOM-O
programme.desc: AWESOM-O: When Cartman disguises himself as a robot in order to play a prank on Butters, he ends up being used by movie execs to come up with film ideas and captured by the military! (S8, E05)

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: While investigating an elderly woman's murder, Grissom receives a miniature crime scene replica; Greg attends a hearing to ascertain his culpability in a teenager's accidental death.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: When identical twins are found dead, the evidence in both cases does not immediately prove a connection between the two deaths. However, as the CSIs dig deeper into the histories of the women, a surprising twist takes the investigation in a new direction.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: Grissom and his team investigate a string of murders in Las Vegas that may be tied to an infamous mob boss from the 1970s who disappeared many years ago.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Monster
programme.desc: After a seemingly drunken man collapses in the barn, 15 Division is put under quarantine. Andy and Swarek work together to find the accomplice of a dyed blue bank robber

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Dov and Gail work together under Swarek’s expert tutelage in a stake-out operation to stop an Asian gang from killing a snitch.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Best Laid Plans
programme.desc: 15 Division’s hunt for an armed robber leads them to the scene of a horrible car accident. While Andy deals with a woman pinned in her car, the other officers must track and apprehend the fugitive

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: Elijah Kane and his team are on the case of a double homicide just as a dirty cop gets involved with Russian drug lord. New cop, Sarah Montgomery is added to the team.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: Elijah Kane gets pressure from Chief Graves to put an end to a Russian drug ring, while newbie cop Sarah proves herself on the street.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: “Black Magic” killer is on the loose, murdering dancers that eerily fit new cop Sarah's description. Kane puts Sarah and Juliet undercover to lure the murderer out.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: Elijah Kane’s detectives look to threaten Kane’s way of doing things while the team has to track down a “Black Magic” copycat before he continues his killing spree.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: ICS must find a sadistic kidnapper before he auctions off his 12-year-old victim on a pedophile website.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: Kessler discovers a Croatian war criminal has been granted amnesty, and must struggle with demons from his own past in Bosnia.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: Three American soldiers plunge into the Niagara River and swim to Canada. Deserters, refusing to return to Iraq under the U.S.’s “stop loss” policy, they seek refugee status in Canada.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: An international assassin, Monita Persaud, turns up in downtown Toronto. Her target: a political cartoonist who has enraged the Muslim world. The ICS squad tracks down Persaud, only to discover a more ominous conspiracy.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: Shipments of poisoned African heroin are hitting the streets of Toronto. Junkies start dying and ICS must race to track down the smugglers. The investigation leads them to a flower merchant, his daughter, and a woman named Abi Mitchell.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: When the CSIs process clues after a murder at a poultry manufacturing plant, the evidence leads them to the home of a man who collects miniature trains and other miniature paraphernalia.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: Catherine's testimony in court is not enough to convict a killer suspected of murdering his own mother. Adam Novak, with whom Catherine had a brief romantic encounter, is the lawyer who represents the killer and secures his freedom.

programme.title: Los reyes del volante
programme.desc: Dos taxistas se hacen cargo de una niña que dejan en su puerta, y cuando ella crece finge ante su novio ser hija de ricos.

programme.title: Operación Carambola
programme.desc: El falso agente de seguridad Ayala, nombra a Capulina como su ayudante numero 13, para preparar la operación carambola. Capulina se da cuenta que él es carnada del criminal y decide unirse a los otros agentes para acabar con la organización.

programme.title: Santo Contra Capulina
programme.desc: Capulina es un gran admirador del campion el Santo, quien en su tiempo libre ayuda a la policia a resolver difíciles casos criminales. Un cientifico crea un robot igual a Capulina para matar al Santo. El robot y el Santo pronto se enfrentan en la arena.

programme.title: Angelitos Del Trapecio
programme.desc: Torpe y asustado Capulina se ve envuelto en una aventura en las peligrosas alturas del trapecio, todo para ayudar al triunfo de una bella trapecista.

programme.title: Buenos Dias, Acapulco
programme.desc: Los detectives Viruta y Capulina viajan al Puerto de Acapulco para cuidar de Ricardo, el joven hijo de un millonario. Cuando el muchacho es secuestrado, es el turno de Viruta y Capulina de enfrentarse a los maleantes para rescatarlo.

programme.title: Capulina Speedy Gonzalez
programme.desc: En el Oeste, el cartero Speedy sólo lleva una carta de su novia Rosita para él mismo. Un cocinero que castiga a los que no aprueban sus platillos sin picante lo obliga a comer chile. Al comerlo se vuelve rápido y valiente.

programme.title: Capulina chisme caliente
programme.desc: El empleado de la compañía telefónica Capulina escucha conversaciones por los aparatos que repara y cuenta chismes de todo el vecindario, pero cuanto dice siempre es útil para las víctimas del cotilleo.

programme.title: Capulina contra Los Monstruos
programme.desc: Capulina lee historias acerca de los monstrous y cree que existen en la realidad. Está muerto de miedo hasta que descubre que son imaginarios.

programme.title: Capulina contra Los Vampiros
programme.desc: Vampiros agresivos amenazan a Capulina hasta que él encuentra la manera de arrancarles los colmillos con unas pinzas de dentista. Los vampiros chimuelos se vuelven dóciles y beben leche en lugar de sangre.

programme.title: Capulina corazón de león
programme.desc: Capulina accidentalmente adopta un león de una tienda de mascotas, pensando que es un gato. Las cosas se complican cuando, encima de todo, lo toman por asaltante.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Continuación de ''La mamá de Cartman es una puta sucia'', en el que Cartman quiere averiguar quién es su padre. Con la ayuda de Chef, los chicos tienen que salvar al Doctor Mephesto luego de recibir un disparo.
programme.sub-title: La madre de Cartman es aún una sucia perra

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un violador de gallinas anda suelto en South Park y el Oficial Barbrady no puede atraparlo porque es analfabeto y no puede leer las pistas que deja el criminal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey es despedido de la escuela por perder una hoja de marihuana durante una presentación en contra de las drogas. Entretanto, los chicos tratan de salvar a Ike de su fiesta ''bris'' en donde le harán la circuncisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Aunque todos odian jugar a los quemados, los chicos están obligados a participar en el campeonato. Mientras tanto, Sheila lucha para que se conozca el caso de ''mixlésia de hermanos siameses'' de la enfermera escolar.
programme.sub-title: La dama de los fetos unidos

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos tienen que escribir sobre la guerra de Vietnam así que visitan a Jimbo y Ned en el set de su programa de Caza y Matanza, el cual está compitiendo por el rating con Jesús y Sus Amigos.
programme.sub-title: El sapo Mejicano mirón del sur de Sri Lanka

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El autobús escolar va por una carretera nevada hasta que, por accidente, termina atascado al borde de un barranco. La señora Crabtree sale a buscar ayuda, pero primero les dice a los chicos que si bajan, un monstruo se los comerá.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una prohibición de fuegos artificiales amenaza las festividades del 4 de Julio hasta que el alcalde idea un plan poner a South Park nuevamente en el mapa.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El festival de cine independiente, Sundance, se translada a South Park atrayendo a mucha gente al pequeño pueblo y al parecer, todo esto afecta el medio ambiente, y el Señor Mojón cada vez se encuentra peor.
programme.sub-title: Las bolas de chocolate saladas del Chef

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son obligados por sus madres a dormir en la casa de Kenny para que se contagien la varicela. Al mismo tiempo, Sheila intenta arreglar la amistad perdida entre su marido y el padre de Kenny.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos van de excursión al planetario y un empleado les lava el cerebro con efectos visuales para que quieran volver allí. Mientras, Cartman sólo se preocupa por ganar un casting para salir en el nuevo comercial de “Quesitos Poofs”.
programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert debería dejar las comidas engordantes

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Todo South Park festeja el "Día de las Vacas", que incluye una feria, un monumento y la corrida de las vacas. Mientras tanto, los chicos hacen lo que sea para ganar unos muñecos de Terrance y Philip.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Chef reclama los derechos de la nueva canción de Alanis Morissette, ''Calzón Sucio'', pero de alguna forma termina siendo demandado. Ahora los chicos, Elton John y otros músicos tratan de juntar el dinero para ayudar a Chef.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La ''Tía Regla'' de Stan le regala un pez dorado que le da mucho miedo y comienzan a haber asesinatos que la mamá de Stan trata de encubrir. Mientras tanto, Cartman se comporta muy extraño de repente y tiene barba.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan se fuga de su casa para ir a Nebraska con los demás, a visitar a los parientes de Cartman en Navidad. Allí, los niños quieren ir a ver al Señor Mojón. Mientras, el tío de Cartman y Charles Manson se escapan de la cárcel.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son obligados a escribir una redacción sobre pequeñas empresas junto a Tweek, un niño raro y nervioso, el cual sugiere que la redacción se haga sobre los "Gnomos roba calzones".

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos descubren a un hombre congelado desde hace tres años, y ahora Stan y Kyle se pelean para ver quién lo descubrió y qué nombre ponerle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Varios habitantes de South Park explotan sin razón aparente y Randy es el encargado de descubrir por qué. Por otro lado, los chicos tienen que representar las "Estaciones de la cruz" en misa, y Kyle trata de ''conseguir una erección''.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Chef tiene una novia y al parecer es una relación seria, así que los chicos se preocupan de que pueda convertirse en un hombre diferente. Al mismo tiempo, Cartman tiene problemas en la vista y odia a su oculista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los niños obligan a dos de sus compañeros de clase, Tweek y Craig, a pelear en el patio de la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mientras están de campamento en el bosque, Cartman descubre una especie de animal en extinción. Al principio, la ciudad se alegra de haberlo salvado, pero luego se dan cuenta de que es muy molesto.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La clase del señor Garrison es visitada por Petey, el panda del acoso sexual, quien les enseña a los chicos sobre el tema. Luego, Cartman decide demandar a Stan porque le dijo ''lame culo''.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La señora Cartman se va a una fiesta por la lluvia de meteoritos y deja a su hijo a cuidado de Shelley. Ahora, Cartman tiene que lidiar con los abusos de Shelley, su novio de 22 años y su gata que está celo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan tiene que ir con sus padres a una aburrida fiesta por la lluvia de meteoritos donde los únicos chicos que hay son Butters, Pip, y Dougie. Mientras tanto, Randy y Gerald pasan por una situación incómoda en un jacuzzi.
programme.sub-title: Dos hombres desnudos en un Jacuzzi

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En la noche de la lluvia de meteoritos, Kyle, Kenny y Ike van al campamento de exploradores judíos, donde se aparece Moisés, al que le encanta que le hagan ofrendas de figuras hechas de macarrones y collares hechos con palomitas de maíz.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se enloquecen por "Chinpokomon" (parodia de Pókemon) y quieren comprar los muñecos, los videojuegos y cualquier cosa de ellos. Lo malo es que los japoneses que los hacen les están lavando el cerebro para invadir Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: “Paco, el Flaco” encuentra una nave espacial y la usa para escapar de una secta cristiana en Etiopía, y buscar un nuevo hogar para él y su pueblo. Mientras tanto, el gobierno interroga a los chicos para obtener información sobre Paco.
programme.sub-title: Paco, el Flaco en el espacio

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En Halloween, los chicos quieren asustar a los de quinto grado, así que desentierran el cadáver de la abuela de Kyle. Mientras tanto, la banda Korn está en South Park y unos fantasmas piratas asechan a los habitantes.
programme.sub-title: El misterio del fantasma pirata de Korn

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: A Cartman le regalan un ''mono de fonética'' para ayudarle a ganar el concurso de deletreo. En el concurso, los chicos conocen a Marc y Rebecca, dos hermanos que no van a la escuela ya que estudian en su casa.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Durante una recreación sobre la guerra civil americana, Cartman lidera al ejército de los confederados para atacar a los guerreros de la Unión al otro lado de América para poder ganar una apuesta a Kyle y Stan.
programme.sub-title: La insignia roja de la homosexualidad

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Señor Mojón nos presenta los clásicos musicales de Navidad cantados por los habitantes de South Park en su propio especial. Incluye los hits: "Dreidel", "Noche de Paz" y muchos más.
programme.sub-title: Clásicos De Navidad Del Sr. Mojón

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman y Kenny creen estar menstruando, pero en realidad tienen una infección de colon, y Kyle y Stan también quieren menstruar. Mientras tanto, se acerca el segundo milenio y los habitantes le exigen a Jesús que se presente Dios.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos viajan a Arkansas para participar en un concierto de flauta dulce y Cartman trata de lograr tocar el ''ruido marrón'', una nota que hace que las personas se caguen encima.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los niños roban dientes a los niños menos afortunados y los venden al hada de los dientes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos van al ''Cirque Du Cheville'', un circo franco-canadiense en donde, al ver a las quintillizas contorsionistas de Rumania, se les ocurre crear su propio circo. Mientras tanto, las cinco niñas se escapan del circo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Todos los niños de South Park son diagnosticados con el S.F.A. (El Síndrome de Falta de Atención) después de que el nuevo alumno minusválido, Timmy, fuese diagnosticado erróneamente también.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuento Southparkitero del libro "Grandes Esperanzas" de Dickens, teniendo como protagonista a Pip, un inglés de clase pobre, y con Malcolm McDowell, un británico como narrador.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman cree que es demasiado maduro como para salir con Stan, Kyle y Kenny, y decide buscar nuevos amigos en internet, pero termina metiéndose con un montón de pedófilos.

programme.title: La leyenda del gigante de la montaña
programme.desc: En esta aventura de la mitología nórdica, Espen "Ash Lad" embarca en una peligrosa aventura.

programme.title: Alex Rider: Operación Stormbreaker
programme.desc: Alex Rider cree que es solo un chico normal, hasta que su tío es asesinado en una misión.

programme.title: Dejados atrás: El mundo en guerra
programme.desc: El presidente de EE.UU pide a un periodista y sus seguidores que detengan un plan mortal.

programme.title: El imperio prohibido
programme.desc: Un cartógrafo emprende un viaje para mapear las tierras inexploradas de Transilvania.

programme.title: Doble amenaza
programme.desc: Una joven con doble personalidad arrastra a un hombre a una fuga entre mafiosos.

programme.title: Balas voladoras
programme.desc: Un detective investiga muertes misteriosas en una fábrica de balas.

programme.title: La hiena indomable 2
programme.desc: Un joven luchador reúne fuerzas para enfrentar a dos temibles maestros de kung-fu.

programme.title: Contención
programme.desc: Un thriller emocionante sobre supervivencia en una zona de cuarentena.

programme.title: El sustituto
programme.desc: El hijo gay de un líder de la Tríada intercambia identidad con su compañero.

programme.title: La Ciudad de Las Sombras
programme.desc: Un corredor de seguros de Nueva York busca a su socio corrupto en Camboya.

programme.title: Ajuste de Cuentas
programme.desc: Roy es un ladrón retirado que se une a su hermano y dos cómplices para un último trabajo: robar una joyería. El robo tiene éxito, pero es traicionado por uno de los bandidos, que mata a su hermano. Roy ahora quiere vengarse de su ex compañero.

programme.title: Lucha por la Libertad
programme.desc: En el estado de Manchukuo en la década de 1930, cuatro agentes especiales del Partido Comunista, luego de regresar a China, se embarcan en una misión secreta. Vendido por un traidor, el grupo se encuentra rodeado de amenazas por todos lados.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: Un hombre confiado y desencantado se encuentra trabajando como espía en el peligroso y arriesgado mundo del espionaje corporativo. Rápidamente superándose, se une a una misteriosa mujer fatal.

programme.title: El Rostro Oscuro de la Ley
programme.desc: Ambientada durante los disturbios de Rodney King, una investigación de homicidio por robo desencadena una serie de eventos que harán que un oficial corrupto de LAPD cuestione sus tácticas.

programme.title: La Apuesta Final
programme.desc: Narra tres historias que se relacionan entre sí y con el mundo del juego y las apuestas, del que se derivan consecuencias nefastas para la vida de los protagonistas.

programme.title: Venganza Fatal
programme.desc: Chapman es un exmarine que vive en los barrios marginales de Brasil y lucha contra la banda yakuza que atacó a su hermana y la dio por muerta.

programme.title: Locos Por El Dinero
programme.desc: El director de una prisión obliga a dos hombres a casarse con sus hijas porque cree que están embarazadas. Los nuevos cuñados deciden robar un tren y escapar. Mientras tanto, un agente del FBI llega a la ciudad para investigar la muerte de un preso.

programme.title: Bajo Amenaza
programme.desc: Jeff Talley, un ex negociador de rehenes, intenta rescatar a una familia secuestrada en su nueva ciudad. Sin embargo, el padre de la familia guarda secretos peligrosos y delincuentes inestables complican su misión.

programme.title: MTV Flow Latino
programme.desc: Sumérgete en los ritmos que te aceleran el corazón y las melodías vibrantes de las estrellas más grandes de la música latina.

programme.title: MTV Flow Latino

programme.title: Seriously Amazing Objects LT
programme.desc: Únase a los visitantes del Smithsoniano en una aventura cercana con Toro Sentado, Rosie la remachadora y Thomas Edison.

programme.title: Seriously Amazing Objects LT
programme.desc: Vea una famosa computadora portátil, una pepita de la época de la fiebre del oro, a Óscar el Gruñón y la chalina roja de Susan B. Anthony.

programme.title: Seriously Amazing Objects LT
programme.desc: Descubra cómo un día normal en el Smithsoniano puede convertirse en un almuerzo con Abraham Lincoln y un viaje a bordo del Ford Modelo T de 1913.

programme.title: Seriously Amazing Objects LT
programme.desc: Nuestro mundo existe gracias a las herramientas, desde las hachas de piedra utilizadas hace casi dos millones de años a los teléfonos inteligentes de los que dependemos hoy en día.

programme.title: Seriously Amazing Objects LT
programme.desc: Siga a los visitantes del Smithsoniano mientras alimentan a las chitas, aprenden sobre té samurái y conocen la historia de la cometa que ayudó a ganar una guerra.

programme.title: Seriously Amazing Objects LT
programme.desc: Únase a los visitantes del Smithsoniano mientras echan un vistazo de cerca a un corazón artificial, conocen a un héroe de los derechos civiles y se cuelgan de un trapecio.

programme.title: Seriously Amazing Objects LT
programme.desc: Sea testigo de algunos de los objetos más grandes del Instituto Smithsoniano en esta visita única tras bambalinas.

programme.title: Space Disasters LT
programme.desc: Sea testigo de las primeras misiones de la NASA, así como de sus tragedias - tanto en el cielo como en la tierra - mientras empuja los límites de la exploración espacial.

programme.title: Space Disasters LT
programme.desc: Desde el desastre de relaciones públicas del Skylab hasta las tragedias y los accidentes de los transbordadores espaciales, eche un vistazo a los desafíos y los peligros del reingreso a la atmósfera.

programme.title: Space Disasters LT
programme.desc: Observe cómo los astronautas y el personal de Control de Misión han resuelto problemas en forma increíble gracias a su rapidez mental y nervios de acero.

programme.title: Space Disasters LT
programme.desc: Observe cómo los pequeños imprevistos, como un tornillo sin revestimiento o un inodoro defectuoso, pueden convertirse en grandes emergencias cuando ocurren en el espacio.

programme.title: Space Disasters LT
programme.desc: Desde las tormentas solares de clase X en el espacio hasta severos rayos en la Tierra, vea por qué el clima representa una amenaza constante para la NASA.

programme.title: Space Disasters LT
programme.desc: Desde el Vanguard estadounidense en 1957 hasta el Vega europeo en 2019, analizaremos más de 60 años de vuelos espaciales que fracasaron sobre la plataforma de lanzamiento.

programme.title: The Accordion Kings
programme.desc: Desde el detrás de escena, hasta el centro del escenario, sea parte de la celebración y la competencia de los mejores acordeonistas del mundo en el Festival Vallenato Kings.

programme.title: The Curious Life and Death of…. LT
programme.desc: Examinaremos la misteriosa muerte de Brittany Murphy por medio de testimonios de testigos, análisis químico y una autopsia virtual.

programme.title: The Curious Life and Death of…. LT
programme.desc: Siga a la Dra. Lindsey Fitzharris mientras investiga famosas muertes envueltas en misterio.

programme.title: The Curious Life and Death of…. LT
programme.desc: ¿Fue el fusilamiento de Pablo Escobar un acto de justicia, venganza o fue un suicidio? Únase a nosotros mientras damos nuestro veredicto.

programme.title: The Lockerbie Bombing
programme.desc: Vea imágenes poco conocidas y escuche historias del atentado de Lockerbie contra el vuelo 103 de Pan Am, uno de los peores desastres aéreos de la historia sucedido en Lockerbie, Escocia.

programme.title: MacGyver LT

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver lucha para salvar a un niño del ominoso destino de una leyenda centenaria.

programme.title: MacGyver LT

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Cuando su avión se estrella en el desierto, MacGyver y cuatro líderes de pandillas adolescentes luchan por sobrevivir.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Cuando MacGyver acepta liberar a un viejo amigo, termina en una misión de rescate en América Central para salvar a otro viejo amigo de unos traficantes de drogas.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver y Pete Thornton viajan al sureste de Asia para rescatar a un grupo de huérfanos, una monja y el antiguo amor de Mac, Debra Easton, cuyas vidas están amenazadas por un régimen opresor.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver y una maestra de escuela sorda, Carrie Linden, viven una pesadilla cuando se topan con el ingenioso plan de un exagente de la CIA para robar un misil, pieza por pieza, y venderlo en el mercado negro.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver lucha contra la mafia mientras protege a una pareja de ancianos que, sin saberlo, se han visto envueltos en una operación de falsificación de un grupo mafioso.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Atrapado dentro de la Fundación Phoenix por un grupo de terroristas, MacGyver se apresura para desactivar una bomba de tiempo y salvar su vida y la de su abuelo.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver es la única esperanza de los Thornton cuando un exagente que busca venganza los toma como rehenes en los pantanos de Luisiana.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver descubre un complot de asesinato contra un informante que amenaza con exponer una red de tráfico de drogas.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver lucha contra exconvictos para salvar la vida de una mujer y su hijo por nacer.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver está tras la pista de ladrones que utilizan tácticas de alto nivel de la Armada para robar un tesoro del siglo XVIII.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Mientras están de vacaciones en las pistas de esquí, MacGyver y Pete Thornton se convierten en objetivos de un escuadrón de "ataques" de la mafia.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver y su compinche bribón Jack Dalton vuelven a estar juntos. Esta vez se enfrentan a un agente de la CIA que acabó mal y sus secuaces, que están sacando de contrabando documentos ultrasecretos del país.
programme.sub-title: Jack Is Back / Dalton, Jack of Spies

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver y Pete Thornton se encuentran de nuevo donde estaban hace siete años: contra un asesino de primer nivel al que creían muerto.

programme.desc: Convocan a MacGyver para rescatar a un piloto de carga estadounidense acusado de espionaje en América Central.

programme.desc: Tras el asesinato de un líder supremacista, su viuda busca venganza con la ayuda de dos fanáticos, que secuestran y torturan a un hombre al que creen responsable.

programme.title: Fago
programme.desc: Tras una reunion politica, Mateo Ibarra, alcalde de Fago, un pequeño pueblo del Pirineo aragones, regresa en su coche por una carretera angosta y nevada. A mitad del camino, unas piedras colocadas en la calzada le obligan a detener su vehiculo.

programme.title: Fago
programme.desc: El hallazgo del coche del alcalde, abandonado lejos del pueblo, permite a los investigadores iniciar el análisis de restos genéticos, mientras el teniente Vidal y el sargento Pacheco interrogan a todo el pueblo y requisan las armas de caza.

programme.title: Fago
programme.desc: Los altos mandos ya conocen la noticia: las muestras analizadas señalan a Eugenio Riaza como artífice del asesinato de Mateo Ibarra.

programme.title: Deadly Secrets

programme.title: El último hijo

programme.title: Bajo la Piel

programme.title: El Asesinato de Carrero Blanco

programme.title: Extra-Terrestres
programme.desc: Una familia, 100,000 pollos con una sentencia de muerte, una niña con un secreto que revelará los de su familia, y una estrella a 2,500 años luz que los hará entender que todos estamos, metafóricamente, fuera de este mundo.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Un hombre convence a su amigo para trabajar como gigoló, lo que provoca situaciones cómicas y complicadas.

programme.title: El amor no es lo que era

programme.title: Navidad vuelve a casa
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de su amor de la infancia y su hijo de seis años, ABBEY redescubre su espíritu navideño mientras recrea los adornos hechos a mano por su abuela para la feria navideña anual de su ciudad natal.

programme.title: Will You Merry Me

programme.title: Amor en pleno vuelo

programme.title: Un amor de verano
programme.desc: Antiguos novios de la infancia fingen ser pareja durante el verano para quitarse de encima a sus abuelas casamenteras.

programme.desc: Kennedy Blaine hereda un magnífico rancho en la pequeña población de Valentine y decide visitar la propiedad para ponerlo en venta. Cuando llega, Derek, el capataz, la confunde con una intrusa y la relación no empieza con buen pie.

programme.title: La fuente de los deseos
programme.desc: La propietaria de una tienda de mascotas de San Francisco se reencuentra con su primer amor y debe resistirse a enamorarse de él por segunda vez.

programme.title: Corazones perdidos

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon & Rozaa Wortham
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jimmy Witherspoon and Rozaa Wortham, two incredible brilliant jazz musicians. Rozaa Wortham starts off the show with the Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet. Swinging and full of energy she performs ‘It Don't Mean A Thing'. Jimmy Witherspoon, known for the song “Ain't Nobody's Business” ends the show with some astounding lean-back blues.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Herbie Mann, Marc Cohen, Romero Lubambo & Paul Socolow
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1990, American flautist Herbert Jay Solomon, better known by his stage name Herbie Mann, was one of the artists appearing here. Together with Marc Cohen on piano, Romero Lubambo on guitar, Paul Socolow on bass, and both Ricky Sebastian and Cyro Baptista on percussion, Herbie Mann performs his infectious take on Brazilian-inspired music in this concert titled 'Jasil Brazz'.

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan, Richard Davis, Ronnell Bright & Art Morgan
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 & 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic. These three performances demonstrate why Sarah Vaughan is invariably mentioned in the same breath as Ella Fitzgerald and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Red Norvo, Dave Brubeck Quartet, The Gary Burton Quartet & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: G.B. 4, Red N., D.G. Band, D.B. 4 - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, jazz's greatest artists appeared at the third Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam. This broadcast features the bands of pianist Dave Brubeck, vibraphonists Gary Burton and Red Norvo, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie.

programme.title: Clark Terry
programme.sub-title: The Skymasters with Clark Terry - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, Dutch big band and radio orchestra The Skymasters took flight at the North Sea Jazz Festival in the Hague. Joining them is jazz legend Clark Terry on trumpet, flugelhorn and vocals in this exciting collaboration.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence. The symphony is structured in six movements, moving from the "awakening of nature" to a spiritual conclusion, inspired by Nietzsche and folk poetry.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons, Berliner Philharmoniker & Hilary Hahn
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world's finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo's magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák's Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber's Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich's Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979)

programme.title: Orquesta Filamonica de Buenos Aires, Carlos Gari, Daniel Barenboim & Mora Godoy
programme.sub-title: A Tango Night - Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: 2006 closed with a spectacular festival of Argentinean music broadcast live from Buenos Aires. At the height of the Argentinean summer, the Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colon under Daniel Barenboim (conductor & soloist) join bandoneon virtuoso Leopoldo Federico and his Orquesta Tipica for an extraordinary New Year's Eve show with popular tangos and Latin American orchestra classics. The old master of tango, José Carli, created enchanting new arrangements of works by Argentinean artists Astor Piazzolla, Carlos Gardel, Julio de Caro, Alberto Ginastera and Horacio Salgán. Performances by leading tango dancers Mora Godoy and Junior Cervilla from Buenos Aires add atmosphere and round off the night.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.title: A Monster Calls

programme.title: Vice

programme.title: My Baby Gone

programme.title: Age of Dragons
programme.desc: In a tale inspired by Herman Melville's Moby Dick, picture a medieval world where Captain Ahab and his crew are on a mission to hunt down the mighty Great White Dragon. Ishmael, the charming harpooner, teams up with his buddy Queequeg to join this daring adventure. The heart of the story is Ahab's burning desire for revenge against the deadly "White Dragon" that wiped out his family in his youth, leaving him with lasting scars. This obsession pushes the crew further into a dark and dangerous journey.

programme.title: Grizzly
programme.desc: An eighteen-foot-tall grizzly bear terrorizes a state park, leaving Ranger Mike Kelly, photographer Allison Corwin, naturist Arthur Scott, and chopper pilot Don Stober to track down the beast. Meanwhile, the body count rises.

programme.title: The Divergent Series
programme.desc: Tris must confront her inner demons and fight against an alliance which threatens to tear her society apart.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Love N' Dancing
programme.desc: Jessica (Amy Smart) had given up on her dream of a life of the stage, until she meets ex-dance champion Jake (Tom Malloy), who becomes her teacher when the couple make an instant connection. Together, they decide to risk it all when they enter the World Swing Championship to reclaim Jake's former title.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: A chronicle of Gertrude Bell's life, a traveler, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer, and political attach for the British Empire at the dawn of the twentieth century.

programme.title: Witch Hunt
programme.desc: Hunted. Persecuted. Executed. The witch trials come to life in modern day America. Claire (Gideon Adlon - The Craft: Legacy) and her mother (Elizabeth Mitchell - The Expanse) are part of an underground movement that ferries women accused of witchcraft to safety. All is well until a new charge brings the witch hunters to their door. Will they also be charged with the ungodly crime of being a witch?

programme.title: The Wicker Man
programme.desc: Based on the hit thriller of the same name and starring Nicolas Cage, this cult classic returns 15 years after its original release. A man finds himself sucked into a twisted community whose secrets and Puritan ways could see a young girl sacrificed. It's a race against time for this outsider to save a life but the residents of Summers Isle may just have other plans.

programme.title: The Hatton Garden Job
programme.desc: A remarkable true story of the largest heist in English legal history. Four ageing East End criminals led by 76 year-old Brian Reader (Larry Lamb) drill into a steel-and-concrete secured safety deposit vault in Londons Hatton Garden jewellery quarter. With everyone from the Hungarian mob to Scotland Yard on their tail, will they commit the crime of the century or pay with their lives?

programme.title: An Affair
programme.desc: Leading a picture-perfect life with her husband, Anita starts a new job as a PE teacher. But her life takes a dramatic turn when she falls prey to Markus, an obsessive student. As time goes on, the encounters leads to an unthinkable and secret affair. Soon their bond turns dubious, tensions rise and things begin to drastically spiral. A superbly-crafted and taut erotic edge-of-your-seat thriller!

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon & Rozaa Wortham
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jimmy Witherspoon and Rozaa Wortham, two incredible brilliant jazz musicians. Rozaa Wortham starts off the show with the Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet. Swinging and full of energy she performs ‘It Don't Mean A Thing'. Jimmy Witherspoon, known for the song “Ain't Nobody's Business” ends the show with some astounding lean-back blues.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Herbie Mann, Marc Cohen, Romero Lubambo & Paul Socolow
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1990, American flautist Herbert Jay Solomon, better known by his stage name Herbie Mann, was one of the artists appearing here. Together with Marc Cohen on piano, Romero Lubambo on guitar, Paul Socolow on bass, and both Ricky Sebastian and Cyro Baptista on percussion, Herbie Mann performs his infectious take on Brazilian-inspired music in this concert titled 'Jasil Brazz'.

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan, Richard Davis, Ronnell Bright & Art Morgan
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 & 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic. These three performances demonstrate why Sarah Vaughan is invariably mentioned in the same breath as Ella Fitzgerald and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Red Norvo, Dave Brubeck Quartet, The Gary Burton Quartet & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: G.B. 4, Red N., D.G. Band, D.B. 4 - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, jazz's greatest artists appeared at the third Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam. This broadcast features the bands of pianist Dave Brubeck, vibraphonists Gary Burton and Red Norvo, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie.

programme.title: Clark Terry
programme.sub-title: The Skymasters with Clark Terry - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, Dutch big band and radio orchestra The Skymasters took flight at the North Sea Jazz Festival in the Hague. Joining them is jazz legend Clark Terry on trumpet, flugelhorn and vocals in this exciting collaboration.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence. The symphony is structured in six movements, moving from the "awakening of nature" to a spiritual conclusion, inspired by Nietzsche and folk poetry.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons, Berliner Philharmoniker & Hilary Hahn
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world's finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo's magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák's Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber's Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich's Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979)

programme.title: Orquesta Filamonica de Buenos Aires, Carlos Gari, Daniel Barenboim & Mora Godoy
programme.sub-title: A Tango Night - Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: 2006 closed with a spectacular festival of Argentinean music broadcast live from Buenos Aires. At the height of the Argentinean summer, the Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colon under Daniel Barenboim (conductor & soloist) join bandoneon virtuoso Leopoldo Federico and his Orquesta Tipica for an extraordinary New Year's Eve show with popular tangos and Latin American orchestra classics. The old master of tango, José Carli, created enchanting new arrangements of works by Argentinean artists Astor Piazzolla, Carlos Gardel, Julio de Caro, Alberto Ginastera and Horacio Salgán. Performances by leading tango dancers Mora Godoy and Junior Cervilla from Buenos Aires add atmosphere and round off the night.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.
